rationales: The K shell has only the 1s subshell.
The L shell has two subshells, 2s and 2p.
The M shell has three subshells, 3s, 3p, and 3d.
The N shell has four subshells, 4s, 4p, 4d, and 4f.
Atomic radius generally decreases across a period as the nuclear charge increases.
Electron affinity generally becomes greater across a period, though there are exceptions.

Eighty grams is twice the amount needed for one litre of a 1.0 M solution.
